descriptionHtml:
Step up your gaming and content creation performance with the Lenovo LOQ 15IRX9! Powered by a high-performance 13th Gen Intel Core i7 HX-series processor, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 6GB graphics, and a color-accurate 100% sRGB 144Hz display, this laptop offers an exceptional balance of speed, visual fidelity, and reliability.
